text:
Sophie Grant: Chartwell Health asked for a 3-week POC to validate chartwell-18b-clin for automated discharge summaries and medication reconciliation. Main asks: Private/VPC possible, BYOK KMS, ability to opt-out of logging for PHI, and a p95 latency target ~350ms for 1.5k token inputs. Also want a pricing cap for the trial.
Ethan Morales: Do we have an artifact path/tokenizer info? Are they planning to stream long transcripts or chunk first?
Sophie Grant: They provided an S3 link in the NDA: s3://chartwell/models/chartwell-18b-clin.tar.gz. Average inputs ~1.2k tokens, outputs ~200, occasional stitched contexts up to 7k. They prefer private but will start hosted Dedicated if install lead time is long.
Priya Desai: Ops note: for 7k we should enable interleaved KV + prefix caching and consider kv-pruning. Variant suggestions: chartwell-18b-q4_k_m-kv for quality and chartwell-8b-slim as latency fallback. Run tokenizer diff and rope/rotary check.
Ravi Kapoor: Legal: they'll need DPA + SOC2 and explicit non-training clause. I'll need the security questionnaire filled to kick off legal review. Also confirm BYOK flow and data deletion attestation.
infra-bot: Created ticket POC-10012: "Chartwell chartwell-18b-clin POC - Private/BYOK, perf". Assigned: eng-runtime, sales-eng, legal. Link: <internal/POC-10012>.
Priya Desai: Quick SE runbook snippet:
```
redwoodctl model inspect --model s3://chartwell/models/chartwell-18b-clin.tar.gz
redwoodctl perf run --model chartwell-18b-clin --quant q4_k_m --kv interleaved --seq-len 7168 --batch 1
```
Priya Desai: Also run tokenizer check: `python -c \"from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').encode('sample clinical note'))\"` to verify eos/pad alignment.
Ethan Morales: For a fast POC path suggest: (1) provision 2x A100-80GB Dedicated with KV shards + VPC peering, (2) run perf and give a latency vs quality matrix, (3) offer customer an option to move to Private if they sign the DPA. I'll queue perf jobs now.
Sophie Grant: Chartwell also asked that we disable request-level logging by default for the POC and provide a deletion certificate at the end. Can Legal confirm we can provide that?
Ravi Kapoor: We can include deletion attestation in the DPA addendum and toggle logging for the POC. Need the filled questionnaire to proceed.
Priya Desai: I'll post perf traces and a short summary (p50/p95, throughput) to POC-10012 by EOD tomorrow. Also will test both Triton and XLA paths; last time this family had a custom swish op that impacted Triton.
Ethan Morales: Pricing: I'll draft three options (usage-only with HIPAA uplift, 3-week Dedicated reservation with credits, Private install quote) and include a not-to-exceed cap for the trial. Post by EOD Tue.
Sophie Grant: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll schedule kickoff with Chartwell for Wed 10am ET and attach the security questionnaire and sample prompts. SEs/legal/ops please be ready with perf + the initial pricing sketch.
